verdict: After a delivery, keep only the current user-facing installer and one Converaid desktop shortcut per device. Remove superseded builds, legacy launchers and redundant delivery copies while preserving settings, prompts, project references and transcripts.
why: The user wants an unambiguous current version and does not want old application artifacts left lying around.

decided.quote: English translation: Please delete everything that is no longer current. I do not like all the old versions left lying around.
